parameters.query: SELECT id,user_id,date,datetime,time,meal_type,item_type,item_name,weight,calories,protein,fats,carbs,created_at AS "createdAt",updated_at AS "updatedAt",version FROM vilqa.diary WHERE user_id=$1::bigint AND date=$2 AND deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY time,id;

options.queryReplacement: ={{ [$('When Executed by Another Workflow').first().json.user_id,$('When Executed by Another Workflow').first().json.date || $now.setZone($('When Executed by Another Workflow').first().json.timezone || 'Europe/Moscow').toFormat('yyyy-MM-dd')] }}

parameters.query: SELECT $1::bigint AS user_id,$2::text AS timezone,vilqa.access_check($1::bigint) AS access_allowed;

WITH snapshot AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT CASE WHEN NULLIF($3::text,'') IS NULL THEN vilqa.read_stats_fast($1::bigint,$2::text) ELSE (SELECT CASE WHEN r->>'success'='true' THEN jsonb_build_object('snapshot',jsonb_build_object('profile',r->'profile','logs',r->'entries'),'fallback',NOT(COALESCE(r->'profile','{}') ?& ARRAY['daily_calories','daily_protein','daily_fats','daily_carbs']),'user_id',$1::bigint,'timezone',$2::text) ELSE NULL END FROM (SELECT vilqa.private_api($1::bigint,jsonb_build_object('action','day','date',$3::text),'[]'::jsonb) AS r) day_data) END AS data) SELECT data->'snapshot' AS snapshot,COALESCE((data->>'fallback')::boolean,false) AS fallback,(data->>'user_id')::bigint AS user_id,data->>'timezone' AS timezone FROM snapshot WHERE data IS NOT NULL;
